verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document source-control integration, dev/staging/production environments, or any promotion workflow for Make scenarios. 'Clone a scenario' and a bare 'scenario history' mention are related features, not versioning with promotion. Cloning would only be a manual workaround, and 'scenario history' is unexplained (it could mean run history), so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
